photography_style.lighting: soft natural light, golden hour preferred
photography_style.model: required for hero and lifestyle modules

prompt_templates.hero: E-commerce hero banner for {product_name}. Cinematic full-bleed composition with the garment as the absolute focal point — floating, draped on a minimal form, or styled flat-lay, NOT a plain model standing still. Soft atmospheric background, generous negative space, premium headline area left blank. {visual_style} aesthetic, {language} market style, high-end editorial magazine quality, 8K, no text overlay, no watermark.
prompt_templates.material: Extreme macro texture study of {product_name} fabric. Fill the frame with weave, fiber, or surface finish; directional grazing light reveals craftsmanship. Soft {color} tones, shallow depth of field, professional textile photography. No model, no text.
prompt_templates.detail: Design-driven detail panel for {product_name}. One hero craftsmanship detail (stitching, buttons, collar, bow, print) shown large with elegant shadow and clean background. Macro lens, shallow depth of field, premium quality visible. Layout feels like a magazine close-up, not a flat catalog shot.
prompt_templates.scenario: Lifestyle scene for {product_name} in {scenario_location}. The garment is naturally integrated into an aspirational moment — on a chair, in a wardrobe flat-lay, or worn with only subtle human presence (hands, silhouette). {visual_style} mood, candid editorial style, {language} cultural context. Avoid a stiff model pose against a white void.
prompt_templates.size_chart: Clean, designed size-guide panel for {product_name}. Garment shown with a stylized figure or dimensional diagram, thin elegant measurement lines, minimalist infographic aesthetic, {brand_color} accents, generous whitespace. Placeholder for measurements in {unit}, no actual readable text.
prompt_templates.core_selling: Graphic selling-point panel for {product_name}. Product on one side, 2-4 benefit zones on the other with soft icon-shaped blocks, color blocks, or elegant leader lines. {visual_style} aesthetic, modern DTC brand layout, {language} market. No dense paragraphs, no text.
prompt_templates.craft: Craftsmanship story panel for {product_name}. Split or layered composition showing raw material + finished garment detail + artisan hand or sewing element. Warm analog texture, {visual_style} mood, magazine photo-essay feel. No text overlay.
prompt_templates.pain_point: Problem-to-solution panel for {product_name}. Soft before/after or contrast composition: wrinkled vs smooth, dull vs fresh, uncomfortable vs comfortable. Product appears as the solution. {visual_style} tones, relatable but elegant, no text.
prompt_templates.cta: Final conversion panel for {product_name}. Bold but premium layout: garment hero + prominent rounded CTA block + 1-2 trust micro-badges. {visual_style} background gradient, {language} market style. No garish sale graphics, no text.
